source_status: reuse of verified 028/033 line ledger and canonical; no new full-thesis reading

multiplicative_response_convention.g_l: line-specific residual selection/acceptance after any used gate corrections
multiplicative_response_convention.b_l: signed residual additive net-area bias in corrected numerator units, not a universal efficiency
multiplicative_response_convention.q_l: N_parent*tau_parent*C_E2*E_l^5*B_l in ideal matched photon-yield interpretation
multiplicative_response_convention.eta_l: b_l/(q_l*f_l*g_l), requiring positive net numerator for logarithms

joint_log_response_jacobian.covariance_propagation: Sigma_y = J Sigma_rho J^T for the declared log-residual vector; use full joint primitive Jacobian for correlated count/calibration/gate/background inputs

declared_submodel_only.f_E: (E/E_star)^s with one common s and arbitrary common E_star
declared_submodel_only.scope: exact log response to a common power-law tilt, holding line assignments, energies and other response terms fixed
declared_submodel_only.not_complete_systematics: Small contrast sensitivity or a large slope required by some hypothetical target cannot exclude general efficiency curvature, line-specific gates or additive background

minimum_future_joint_reanalysis_fields: immutable source/run/line/parent/daughter/assignment and energy-calibration identities, with actual uncertainties/Cov
per-line spectrum/projection and exact gate combination, gate role/width, weighting, event reuse, exposure, detector mask, addback/cuts and angular/conditional acceptance
gross peak areas, fit/ROI model, sideband/background/contaminant components, subtraction/transport coefficients and their joint covariance or likelihood
used efficiency and correction convention, calibration parameter values and full parameter Cov, shared run/detector modes and four-energy Jacobian or full four-energy Cov
line-specific gate/acceptance response parameters or corrections and their cross-line/cross-calibration covariance or joint likelihood
373.7-keV normalizer identity and exact sharing/transformation; retain reference covariance if reconstructing normalized intensities, or provide pre-normalization corrected four yields
full four-line corrected-yield covariance and its relation to primitive covariance (to avoid double counting), including cross-parent entries; distribution/coverage/constraints for printed errors
producer/version, fitted nuisance restrictions, control-data provenance and uncertainty-model validation/coverage; missing fields stay unknown
